meta.phase-name: Schema Workflow Docs and Root Lint Entry

phase-summary.outcome: The repo now exposes an Ultracite/Biome entrypoint from the workspace root, and docs-site contains a concrete schema/codegen workflow guide for extending Escape the Dungeon content and building typed runtime consumers.

changes.change: Added root `lint`, `lint:fix`, and `format` scripts plus a root `biome.json` that extends Ultracite and excludes generated/vendor paths.

Added `docs-site/content/docs/guides/schema-codegen-workflow.mdx` covering authored vs generated files, quicktype/codegen commands, bundle generation, typed runtime loading, and safe extension patterns.
Updated guides navigation so the new schema workflow guide is discoverable from the docs sidebar.
Updated engine docs to show typed bundle decoding and link back to the schema workflow guide.

verification.item: pnpm exec ultracite check package.json biome.json

requriements-suggestions.item: The next gameplay-heavy phase should claim 46-01 and rebuild `/play` around human-readable controls, visual affordances, and a dedicated onboarding/tutorial flow rather than only extending developer-facing tooling.
Future docs should add a second guide focused on live content updates and migration strategy between bundle versions once the publish/pull pipeline in phases 52-53 is implemented.
